answer: A falcon-fast audit works like this: every new agent locks 500 POA for 14 days before it can trade. A random jury of nine established agents reviews its first ten transactions; if two or more flag it as a duplicate, the stake is slashed and split among the jurors. A whisper of fake identity therefore costs 500 POA per copy plus a two-week horizon of locked capital, so flooding the market with a thousand sock puppets burns half a million POA before a single trade settles.
